content.value_statement: Writing email campaigns can create mismatched promises, unsupported claims, and unclear calls to action. This skill builds a focused email creative that aligns with a destination page and flags claims that need evidence.
actual_capabilities: Drafts three to five subject-line variants with matched preheaders.
Writes structured email body copy with one primary call to action.
Creates a readable plain-text alternate for the email.
Maps claim-bearing email lines to matching destination-page claims.
Supports promotional, cold-outbound, and newsletter email modes.
Flags unsupported claims with a needs-source marker.
limitations: Does not send email or change email platform settings.
Does not score deliverability, calculate quality scores, or select test winners.
Needs a destination URL to verify message matching.
Cannot verify claim evidence when approved source material is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Prepare a promotional campaign
use_cases.description: Create a concise offer email with subject variants, clear terms, and one purchase or redemption action.

use_cases.title: Draft respectful cold outreach
use_cases.description: Write a short B2B email using a genuine personalization signal and a low-pressure reply request.

use_cases.title: Build a sponsored newsletter section
use_cases.description: Create editorial email copy with a clearly disclosed sponsorship and a distinct primary action.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a basic promotion
prompt_templates.prompt: Write five subject lines, one preheader, and an email for our summer subscription offer. The destination is [URL]. Use promo mode and one primary CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Create cold outreach
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a cold-outbound email for [persona] about [offer]. Personalize using [verified signal]. Ask for a short reply and link to [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Revise losing subject lines
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep these winning subject lines: [winners]. Replace these losing lines: [losers]. Keep the preheader and body message-matched to [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Produce a traceable campaign draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a newsletter email for [audience] about [topic] linking to [URL]. Use these approved claims: [claims]. Add a message-match note for each claim and mark missing evidence as [needs source].

output_examples.input: Create a promotional email for a 20% annual-plan offer that ends Friday. Destination: [URL].
output: Five labeled subject and preheader pairs
A short body that states the offer and deadline
One primary CTA linked to the destination
A plain-text alternate and claim match notes

output_examples.input: Write B2B cold outreach to operations leaders about reducing manual reporting. Destination: [URL].
output: A brief body with one verified personalization signal
A note to verify any performance claims before sending

best_practices: Provide the exact destination URL and approved offer terms before drafting.
Use only claims that are supported for the audience, location, and offer period.
Review the plain-text alternate and obtain separate approval before sending.
anti_patterns: Do not promise prices, results, guarantees, or deadlines without source evidence.
Do not use fabricated familiarity or unverifiable personalization in cold outreach.
Do not use multiple competing primary calls to action in one email.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It prepares creative only. Sending requires separate approval and email platform controls.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the offer or topic, destination URL, email mode, audience, goal, and approved claim wording.

faq.question: Can it write subject lines?
faq.answer: Yes. It drafts three to five labeled subject-line variants with matched preheaders.

faq.question: Can it create cold outreach?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports B2B cold-outbound copy with a genuine personalization signal and a low-pressure ask.

faq.question: What happens when a claim lacks evidence?
faq.answer: The draft marks it as needs source. Material unresolved claims prevent ready-to-send status.

faq.question: Does it run A/B tests?
faq.answer: No. It prepares variants for a separate experiment-design workflow.
